campaign_role: development calibration and mechanism falsification only

attempt_alignment.report_returning_attempts: retain complete step WorkCounters and all error/Krylov diagnostics
attempt_alignment.CoreResult_failure: do not infer phase, eta, or partial work; retain explicit null coverage hole
attempt_alignment.complete_work_gate: zero unscorable failures and exact per-trial/aggregate work equality

geometry.false_reject: actual accepted outcome with eta_c2 > tau
geometry.false_accept: actual rejected-error-control outcome with finite eta_c2 <= tau
geometry.threshold_domain: all distinct finite eta values plus boundary sentinels

batch_calibration.algorithm: double complete-suite repetitions in disabled mode until minimum wall target or hard cap

paired_overhead.cost_authority: Gamma = total wall seconds / total proposed physical interval
paired_overhead.proposed_interval: sum(abs(trial_step_size)) over all attempts, including rejected attempts

hard_fail: any unscorable failure in canonical corpus
any threshold selection or active switching
